chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Lawrence Brown joins Howard's band for the Momart
summary: Howard says Lawrence Brown played with him at the Momart, got a minor illness back East later, and came from Pasadena with his brother Harold.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: What do you know about Lawrence Brown? I'm just trying to think of some of these people --
Lawrence Brown?
-- that played in Los Angeles.
Well, Lawrence Brown came here -- of course, he came here and the first thing he did was get sick. And he played with me.
When you say he came here, he wasn't born here.
He played with me, out there at the Omar Room. What is it, Omar? What is the name of that place down on --
(Inaudible.)
No. She ain't paying no attention. She's busy with the -- huh?
Was she working in the club, too, at the time?
Yeah, but she was busy singing and dancing.
She'd know the name of the club,
though, wouldn't she?
You want to ask her?
Yeah.
Excuse me.
Hey, babe, mama.
We want to know if you knew the name of the club when Lawrence Brown first worked -- he said you were busy dancing and singing. I said you might know.
You remember who he was with?
Let's see.
You have an idea what location that was?
Lawrence Brown started working with you at the -- when you organized the band to go into the Momartre.
In the Momart, yeah, yeah. That's good, that's good, she did it.
You said he got sick. What do you mean, like, he had to go to the hospital or something?
Who?
Lawrence Brown. He said he got sick.
No.
No, he didn't have to go to the hospital.
He didn't take sick here. Lawrence took sick back East when he was with -- who was he with?
I don't know who he was with.
I was with -- I think it was Duke or --
Well, he got with Duke later, I think.
When he left here, he left to go with Duke.
Uh-huh.
Yes, that's --
He got sick then, you say?
Yes, but not for long. I think it was just a minor illness.
Uh-huh. Now, --
We used to hear from him every Christmas.
He and his brother Harold, right? They're from what, Pasadena?
Yes.
Yeah, Pasadena.
Were they born there or just sort of moved there from --
Yeah, they were -- no --
I think they were born -- I don't know.
They were born there.
But Harold wasn't. Harold never did go on the road.
